summary: Clatsop County, OR tower 10 miles east of Seaside: 40-ft pole tower and cabin in 1933, abandoned 1965, listed gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 40-foot pole observation tower with a cabin (1933)
facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association index lists the tower as gone; the Forest Lookouts page says removed, with no date; no source describes the site today
facts.agency: Oregon Department of Forestry (Forest Lookouts page); Northwest Oregon FPA (firelookout.com)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts page gives Oregon Department of Forestry; firelookout.com gives Northwest Oregon FPA. The story reports both. Facts keep the brief's ODF value because two pages name it, and the story says the sources disagree.

notes_for_editor: Do not merge with us-or-green-mountain-clatsop-county: that record is the Vernonia-area site (firelookout.com greenmtn44a; index 45.87688 -123.39944; FFLOS US 1173, OR 497). Both are Clatsop County Green Mountains, and firelookout.com uses 'Green Mtn.' for both. This record (46.01858 -123.70545, 10 miles east of Seaside) has no FFLOS or NHLR number in the index. No staffing, fire or access information was found in the sources read.
